_note: Registered values for Paper 3 (book Test 4), fixed before any army figure is collected. See PROTOCOL.md.

W.use: list of wars only; never a source of figures

texts: Diodorus, Library 2.1-20 (Ninus and Semiramis, from Ctesias)
Hervarar saga (battle of the Goths and Huns)
T.rule: every war episode in these texts that gives a number for an army

frames.headline_figure: largest force any ancient source gives for any one side
frames.sensitivity_figure: median ancient figure for the war

classification.A: independently attested: (i) a document or inscription within 50 years naming or describing the event, or (ii) event-specific archaeology, or (iii) two independent ancient narrative sources
classification.U: unattested: known only from one tradition whose earliest surviving form is at least 300 years after the purported date, with none of (i)-(iii)
classification.M: anything else; excluded from the primary analysis
classification.reliability: Cohen's kappa between two humans only; AI never counts as a coder (rules section 9)

measures.population: highest of HYDE 3.3 upper scenario (summed over the region's modern countries) and McEvedy and Jones (1978), at the nearest date; for a date range, the date giving the largest population
measures.arms_mix: foot / (chariots + elephants), where both are given

decision.test_Q1_Q2: one-sided Fisher exact; LR = share(U) / share(A), 95% interval by Katz log method, 0.5 added to every cell if any is zero
decision.test_Q3: one-sided Mann-Whitney U; ratio of medians for equivalence

answers.No: 95% interval for LR wholly inside the equivalence band, or wholly below 1
answers.Not settled: anything else, or fewer than the minimum wars per group, or the gate fails

R1.basis: 1.2.15-24: the text's count of units, one man each

R2a.basis: 5.152.21-22 as senas: 9,000 elephants and 9,000 chariots, one man each, a minimum

R2b.basis: 5.152.21-22 as vahinis, one man each, a minimum
